title: Inquest ordered in police shooting of 18-year-old student: [FINAL C Edition]
article: The B.C. Coroners Service will hold an inquest into the death of an 18-year-old Iranian student who was shot and killed by a Port Moody police officer last July.
Keyvan Tabesh was finishing his last year of high school when he was shot to death by the officer, who said Tabesh approached him while wielding a machete that he had also used to strike a vehicle.
The inquest will take place Jan. 18-21 in Burnaby.
A coroner and five-person jury will hear evidence from witnesses to determine the facts surrounding Tabesh's death.
The jury will also make recommendations aimed at preventing deaths under similar circumstances in the future.
On Wednesday, the B.C. Attorney-General's Ministry announced it would not pursue charges against the unnamed officer.
